title: mentha pedunculata
intro: Mentha pedunculata, commonly known as Horn Mint, is a species of mint plant in the family Lamiaceae. It is a perennial herb native to the Mediterranean region, known for its square stem and small, purple flowers. The health benefits of Mentha pedunculata include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help soothe digestive issues, reduce stress, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Horn Mint include its ability to relax the muscles, reduce pain, and improve respiratory function, which is attributed to its bioactive constituents, including menthone, limonene, and rosmarinic acid.
